label: Report-scoped nominee-interest reduction vocabulary for tax year 2025. The published prefix is a derived tax consequence for one identified Form 1099-INT report, not a source-document amount and not a Schedule B form-row claim.

fact_types.title: The report-scoped nominee-interest reduction for one identified Form 1099-INT: the sum of current nominee-allocation amounts on that report when the set is supportable. Identity shares the box-1 report's payer, statement, and tax-year components. Not a remainder citizen, not a source-document amount, and not a Schedule B line binding.
